statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2021-0127 is an informational unmaintained-crate notice for serde_cbor, not a vulnerability: there is no vulnerable code to be present. Recorded per the L2 contract (known, decided, written down); the dependency migration is ordinary maintenance, not a security action. The decision is a fact about serde_cbor@0.11.2, so the product names the dependency: every release whose SBOM ships this exact package@version is covered by derivation, and a release that bumps the version is deliberately NOT covered — a changed version is a fresh judgment. Blast-radius query behind this decision: audit:blast-radius, 2026-08-11.
